judgment.rationale: The report says Keyboard Manager loses or changes shortcut bindings and application visibility settings after relaunch or reboot, but it provides no exact mapping, configuration file, or reproducible persistence sequence.
evidence: The reporter says they must change an Alt binding to Ctrl because the selected binding is lost.
They say relaunch changes an application setting from visible to hidden and ask whether configuration must be manually backed up.
The report names PowerToys 0.96.1 and has no comments or attachments.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask for the exact affected binding/application row and the sequence that changes it, then distinguish persistence failure from editing or UI state.

fix_assessment.rationale: The issue does not identify a specific shortcut, application entry, save action, or current reproduction, so no configuration-persistence fix can be scoped.

issue_context.summary: An under-specified Keyboard Manager report says shortcut bindings and an application visibility value change after relaunch or reboot.
known_information: The reported changes include an Alt-to-Ctrl binding and an application field changing from normal/visible to hidden.
The reporter asks whether manual backup is required after editing.
There are no comments or attachments.
inferences: The symptom could be a persistence defect, an unexpected UI default, or an edit not being saved; the report does not distinguish them.
issue_context.analysis: A targeted clarification should capture the exact row and sequence of edits/restart that changes it. Avoid asking for a general bugreport before a deterministic persistence scenario exists.
initial_investigation: Read the full issue body and confirmed there are no comments.
No linked PR or related issue is identified.

information_gaps.information: The exact shortcut row and application-visibility value before and after relaunch, plus the edit/save/restart sequence.
information_gaps.why_needed: The report mentions two different settings changing but does not say whether they belong to the same row or when the changes occur.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Reply with the specific source/destination shortcut and application row, the values before and after restarting PowerToys, and whether the change occurs after sign-out/reboot or only a relaunch.

actions.label: Identify the binding that changes after relaunch

comment.body: You report that an Alt binding changes to Ctrl and that an application setting changes from visible to hidden after relaunch. To isolate the persistence issue, could you identify the exact shortcut row and application row involved, the values before and after restarting PowerToys, and whether this happens after a PowerToys relaunch, sign-out, or reboot?
